name: Govee Lights
author: ant456
description: Web portal for the Govee light effects that the NFL, NBA and NHL plugins play when a team scores. Pick your lights (Govee LAN control or Home Assistant), pick an effect for each moment with live previews, choose team colors or your own, and press Test. Shows nothing on the panel.

versions.notes: Sections: set how many sections each light has (filled in automatically for Home Assistant lights with numbered segments), a Show sections button that lights each section in turn so you can count them, and previews and the Test button that use them.

First release: light picker (LAN scan, Home Assistant, by address), per-light on/off and blink, effect picker with animated previews, per-sport overrides, team or custom colors, and a Test button that plays the current form on the chosen lights and then restores them.
